purpose: Teach: タップ/ブロードウェイ/弱み/できあがり/打ち明け/年末年始/放り/おしえ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、ご祭りで太鼓のタップを聞いたぞ
lines.en: You know, Gran, when I was young I heard the festival drums — the way they'd tap.
lines.style: Soft, reflective opening. Gaze turned inward to a distant memory. Pause before the verb — searching. Warm, almost dreamy pacing. The voice of a man sitting in stillness, not performing nostalgia but living in it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ブロードウェイ憧れていらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Mm, yes — you always loved Broadway, didn't you, dear? Even back then.
lines.style: Gentle correction, the kind of fact-check that comes from sixty years of knowing someone. Warm, conversational, eyes on him. Slight smile in the tone — affection underneath the reminder.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、ばあさんの弱みを支えたぞ
lines.en: And when you were younger, Gran, you held me up when I was weak.
lines.style: Lower register, more deliberate. The confession sits heavier. Hands maybe still, maybe reaching for her hand. Gratitude underneath — not quite asking forgiveness, but acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんが、お料理のできあがりに満足されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You were always so happy when the cooking turned out just right, weren't you, love?
lines.style: Playful tease in the warmth. A small laugh threaded through. She's turning his memory over gently, showing him another side of it. Tender but alive — not sad.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんに本音を打ち明けたぞ
lines.en: When I was young, Gran, I told my father things I'd never told anyone else.
lines.style: Quieter still. A man carrying the weight of a confession even now. Honesty without excuse. Pause after the subject — the vulnerability costs something.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、年末年始のお餅つきがお好きでしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You loved making mochi at New Year's, didn't you? I can still see you doing it.
lines.style: Image-maker's voice — she's painting a picture for him, for herself. Gentle and specific. The words move at her natural pace, unhurried. Love wrapped in small details.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、ぼろ布を放りっぱなしにしてしまったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, I left something behind. Left it lying there without care.
lines.style: Regret surfacing quietly. Not self-pitying — factual and sad. The pace slows at the end. A man sitting with something unresolved, finally speaking it aloud.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんに古い言葉をおしえていただいたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You taught me so many old words, didn't you? Beautiful ones I've never forgotten.
lines.style: Her voice wraps around the memory like a gift being opened slowly. Intimate and close — the affection in it is almost a whisper. She's giving him something back.
